verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is API-driven: subscriptions can be created through the Subscriptions API, and an official CLI lets users build, test and manage the integration from the command line. Together these let automation run without the Dashboard. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI pipeline usage, non-interactive authentication for CI, or headless test-mode workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage documentation (e.g. non-interactive CLI auth or CI examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
